header.name: Advanced Linear Algebra
header.description: This course is designed to enhance the understanding of the principles underlying the subject and to prepare students to take more advanced courses in Mathematics and engineering (e.g. Machine learning, Advanced Matrix Theory, Algebraic Coding Theory).

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to write down formal Mathematical proofs

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to solve mathematical problems involving matrices using advanced linear algebra tools.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to classify matrices and linear operators defined on finite-dimensional vector spaces.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students can identify special properties of a matrix, such as nonsingular, diagonalizable etc.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to determine best approximate solutions of inconsistent system of linear equations.

lecture_topics: Review of Fields, Finite Fields, vector spaces
Matrix of a linear transformation and change of basis
Fundamental theorem of vector space homomorphism
Cyclic decomposition and the rational and Jordan canonical forms
Symmetric and skew- symmetric bilinear forms
Generalized inverse of a matrix and its applications

weekly_plan.week: Extra topics (for PhD and other interested students)

resources.title: Hoffman and Kunze, Linear Algebra, Pearson.
Horn and Johnson, Matrix Analysis, Cambridge University Press.
Horn and Johnson, Topics in Matrix Analysis, Cambridge University Press.
